cohort: 20,017 women from 193 hospitals in 21 countries participating in the World Maternal Antifibrinolytic (WOMAN) trial
finding: Placenta praevia/accreta, advanced maternal age, cesarean section, and giving birth in Asia were identified as significant risk factors for peripartum hysterectomy.
mod_finding: Cesarean section was associated with a fourfold higher odds of peripartum hysterectomy compared to vaginal delivery.
country: 21 countries (Africa, Asia, Europe and the Americas)
